plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 42 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.53576, -132.1428, pull off on Yakoun Main (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 160 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-13, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
16 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
5 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 43 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Oceanview Dr, Queen Charlotte Mainline FSR, Queen Charlotte Mainline, unsigned.

Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
